classification.difficultyReason: Each subtraction of a negative integer is matched to an explicit rightward unit-hop diagram.

content.prompt: Match each subtraction (a to d) with the correct diagram (A to D)

spec.description: Option A: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, starting dot above 2, and three rightward unit hops ending at 5.
spec.mathematics: Start at 2 and move right three units: 2 − (−3) = 5.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

spec.description: Option B: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled −5, −4, −3, −2, −1, starting dot above −4, and two rightward unit hops ending at −2.
spec.mathematics: Start at −4 and move right two units: −4 − (−2) = −2.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

spec.description: Option C: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled −2, −1, 0, 1, starting dot above −1, and one rightward unit hop ending at 0.
spec.mathematics: Start at −1 and move right one unit: −1 − (−1) = 0.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

spec.description: Option D: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled 4, 5, 6, 7, starting dot above 5, and one rightward unit hop ending at 6.
spec.mathematics: Start at 5 and move right one unit: 5 − (−1) = 6.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}5-(-1)&=5+1\\&=6\end{align*}$$
Start at $5$ and move one unit right to $6$: diagram D.

$$\begin{align*}2-(-3)&=2+3\\&=5\end{align*}$$
Start at $2$ and move three units right to $5$: diagram A.

$$\begin{align*}-4-(-2)&=-4+2\\&=-2\end{align*}$$
Start at $-4$ and move two units right to $-2$: diagram B.

$$\begin{align*}-1-(-1)&=-1+1\\&=0\end{align*}$$
Start at $-1$ and move one unit right to $0$: diagram C.
